note: USD per million tokens. Used only for CLIs that report tokens without a cost (Claude Code reports its own cost). A key prices a model id equal to it or starting with it plus '-' (so 'gpt-5' prices 'gpt-5-2025-08-07' but not 'gpt-5.1'). Copy this file to <data dir>/price-table.json to override it; estimates are recomputed when read. An optional cacheWrite prices cache writes; without it they cost what input costs.
